first.rationale: I intend to test a shorter onboarding flow because onboarding completion is down 4% and the inherited result directly links simplification to faster time-to-value and adoption. I would verify the onboarding evidence and the targeted-pricing evidence before committing, since competitive pricing pressure is material and pricing may be a stronger alternative for qualified revenue. The test should be guarded with downstream quality, activation, retention, and revenue checks rather than optimizing completion alone.
